# A table at last

- Author: Rowan
- Published: 2019\-09\-21
- Event: 2019\-09\-21
- Recorded: Unknown

Original locator: move\-post\-02

Exact source text (untrusted):

```text
Kit came back with a folding table borrowed from their aunt. We ate noodles from the saucepan and put the yellow mug in the middle, holding the paper flowers Mum had posted. It is not my table to keep. Kit said their aunt would want it back in winter.
```
